notes:
{本屋|ほんや} is the everyday word for a bookstore; ⟦{書店|しょてん}→書店：04205_shoten⟧ is the word on signs and in writing. The suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ marks a shop or the person who runs it, so {本屋|ほんや} can also mean the bookseller, and {本屋|ほんや}さん is the friendly way to say either.
